"""Limited-mode MuJoCo ALOHA controller record.

Uses only RGB/depth camera observations, camera calibration, and robot joint
proprioception. There is deliberately no simulator/model/state access here.
The interactive episode was driven in short observations and joint-position
chunks; pass --execute to run the conservative final approach on a live episode.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

CAM = "overhead_cam"
WATCH = ["overhead_cam", "teleoperator_pov"]


def decode_objects(rgb: np.ndarray, depth: np.ndarray, intrinsics, cam2world):
    """Return saturated red/blue pixel centroids and depth-backprojected points."""
    rgb = np.asarray(rgb)
    d = np.asarray(depth).squeeze().astype(float)
    if d.shape != rgb.shape[:2]:
        d = d.reshape(rgb.shape[:2])
    red = (rgb[..., 0] > 125) & (rgb[..., 0] > 1.5 * rgb[..., 1]) & (rgb[..., 0] > 1.5 * rgb[..., 2])
    blue = (rgb[..., 2] > 110) & (rgb[..., 2] > 1.35 * rgb[..., 0]) & (rgb[..., 2] > 1.2 * rgb[..., 1])
    K = np.asarray(intrinsics, float)
    T = np.asarray(cam2world, float)
    out = {}
    for name, mask in (("red", red), ("blue", blue)):
        y, x = np.where(mask)
        if not len(x):
            out[name] = None
            continue
        u, v = float(x.mean()), float(y.mean())
        z = float(np.median(d[mask]))
        # CV camera ray to OpenGL camera coordinates, then world coordinates.
        p_cv = np.array([(u-K[0, 2])*z/K[0, 0], (v-K[1, 2])*z/K[1, 1], z])
        p_gl = np.array([p_cv[0], -p_cv[1], -p_cv[2], 1.0])
        world = (T @ p_gl)[:3]
        out[name] = {"pixel": [u, v], "depth_m": z, "world_m": world.tolist(), "pixels": int(len(x))}
    return out


def camera_report(obs):
    meta = obs.meta
    cam = meta["cameras"][CAM]
    depth = obs.depth[CAM]
    rgb = obs.last[CAM]
    return decode_objects(rgb, depth, cam["intrinsic_cv"], cam["cam2world_gl"])


def move_joint_target(robot: Robot, target, seconds: float, note="vision-guided joint step", cameras=WATCH):
    """Ramp from current commanded target to a 14-joint target."""
    spec = robot.spec()
    dt = max(spec["control_dt"], min(0.1, seconds))
    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(seconds / dt)))
    dt = seconds / n
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=[CAM])
    q = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], float)
    start = q[28:42].copy()
    lo = np.asarray(spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["lower"], float)
    hi = np.asarray(spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["upper"], float)
    end = np.clip(np.asarray(target, float), lo, hi)
    rows = np.asarray([start + (end-start)*f for f in np.linspace(1/n, 1, n)])
    return robot.submit("joint_position", rows, dt=dt, interpolate="linear", cameras=cameras,
                        video="both", include_depth=True, note=note)


def diagnostic(robot: Robot):
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=WATCH, include_depth=True)
    print(json.dumps({
        "time_left_s": obs.meta.get("time_left_s"),
        "proprio_now": obs.meta["proprio"]["now"],
        "objects_from_overhead": camera_report(obs),
        "task": obs.meta.get("task", {}),
    }, indent=2))
    return obs


def conservative_final_approach(robot: Robot):
    """Small final right-arm move; all targets are clipped by the published spec."""
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=[CAM], include_depth=True)
    target = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][28:42], float).copy()
    # Keep left arm where it is. Close right gripper and hold its observed pose;
    # callers should use the images/depth report to decide whether to continue.
    target[13] = 0.003
    return move_joint_target(robot, target, 0.8, note="hold observed pose and close right gripper")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--execute", action="store_true", help="run one conservative close step")
    parser.add_argument("--save", default="/app/output/final_diagnostic", help="diagnostic observation directory")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    robot = Robot()
    obs = diagnostic(robot)
    obs.save(args.save)
    if args.execute:
        conservative_final_approach(robot)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
